phase3_findings.description: The stopped-note selector's realistic glyph-prefixed status input is never exercised: run.sh passes bare 'Failed'/'Cancelled' while production (the stall backstop) writes glyph-prefixed statuses that flow through _strip_status_glyph; a regression in the glyph strip or _STATUS_GLYPHS would silently disable the mirror for every real stop terminal while the test stays green. Add a glyph-prefixed status row.

If sourcing lib/resolve-gh.sh fails (the partial-deployment case the code anticipates) devflow_resolve_gh is undefined and DEVFLOW_GH is exported empty; the helper's own gh calls then run an empty command and fail with a misleading breadcrumb while the Python child recovers via 'or gh'. Fall back to literal gh so both halves degrade identically. Net effect stays fail-closed.

In the gate pipeline (pr-note-block.py strip | refresh-pr-run-link.py) coupling strip-success to link-refresh-success means a body with a note block but no [View run] line could fail to strip on the gate path; recoverable via the separate agent-side strip. refresh-pr-run-link.py was confirmed to return the body unchanged (exit 0) when no [View run] line is present, so this is not actually reachable.

The added resume-maintenance inline comment block in devflow-implement.yml is four physical source lines and its second half is safety-net rationale rather than the specific wrong change prevented; under the prevention-only comment standard (workflow/YAML population) an added block over three lines is a Suggestion. Consider trimming.

The _cmd_update_inner mirror call site (workpad.py:988-993) is not exercised end-to-end; each piece is unit-tested in isolation but no test drives update --status Failed through _cmd_update_inner to confirm the wiring reads the correct _own_notes/_own_reflections and fires only after the PATCH lands. The workflow-YAML wiring is separately adjudicated unobservable, but this Python call site is observable.

The gate YAML rc-threshold branch (RPOR_RC -ge 3) has no behavioral coverage; only the invocation line is pinned. Flagged for completeness; falls under the recorded routing/dispatch-contract adjudication, no action needed if that stands.

refresh-pr-on-resume.sh arg parser uses 'shift 2' for --issue/--run-url; a valueless trailing flag makes shift 2 fail without decrementing arg count so the loop hangs. Unreachable via the sole caller (the gate always passes value tokens); robustness-only.

gh api --jq '.body' emits literal 'null' for a JSON-null PR body, which passes the empty-body guard in both refresh-pr-on-resume.sh and workpad.py's mirror; PRFlow-created PRs always carry a real body and this mirrors refresh-pr-run-link.py callers, so not a regression this PR introduces.

checklist_skipped: not-run-in-shadow (blinded shadow audit ran the full Phase 3 roster plus direct AC verification in place of a fresh Phase 1/2 checklist generation)
report: Blinded shadow re-review (iteration 3) of PR #2063 / issue #2060 at HEAD f4959bdf0. Full Phase 3 roster of 5 dispatched cold with no prior findings; all 5 returned real assessments. type-design-analyzer correctly gated out (no new types). No Critical findings and no documented_falsehood / self-contradicting-diff findings — all three comment/doc reviewers verified the doc and comment claims true against HEAD. One Important finding: a single-source test-coverage gap (the stopped-note status selector is exercised only with bare-word statuses, never the glyph-prefixed Failed/Cancelled the stall backstop actually writes through _strip_status_glyph); the shipped code is correct, so this is a coverage-hardening note, not a correctness defect, and sits below the default 'critical' verdict threshold. Remaining findings are Suggestions (fail-closed DEVFLOW_GH degradation cosmetics, an unreachable shift-2 arg-parse hang, a JSON-null body edge shared with pre-existing helpers, an over-three-line workflow comment, and two additional test-wiring seams). ACs 1-9 independently verified as satisfied at HEAD: AC1 gate adopt arm invokes refresh-pr-on-resume.sh with warn-and-skip arms and the agent-side link rewrite retired; AC2/AC3 _stopped_note_text_for_mirror selects exactly Failed/Cancelled status + blocked reflection (Complete and all else -> None), backstop arms carry the run-died note; AC4 branch-setup strip now runs on every resume and the gate strips on cloud resumes; AC5 pr-note-block.py add/strip are byte-faithful, idempotent, fail-closed on empty/missing args; AC6 mirror placed after the workpad PATCH and wrapped in except Exception; AC7 status glyphs/vocabulary untouched (_strip_status_glyph reused, not modified); AC8 pr-description SKILL.md gains the Strip-do-not-preserve rule; AC9 DEVFLOW_SYSTEM_OVERVIEW.md now describes the gate-job seam and drops the accepted-stale-link-window sentence. phase-1-setup.md's SCRIPTS operand list and GITHUB_RUN_ID note are reconciled with branch-setup.md (refresh-pr-run-link.py -> pr-note-block.py). Verdict: APPROVE with notes.
